name: Level_1 - Task_9
description: Evaluate the Γ-point vibrational Zero-Point Energy (ZPE) of bulk Silicon using finite-displacement harmonic analysis. Start with a primitive diamond unit cell of Silicon (a = 5.43 Å). The MACE-MP-0 foundation model should be used as the ASE-compatible calculator to describe interatomic interactions. Perform a geometry optimization of the atomic positions using the BFGS optimizer until the maximum residual force is below 0.01 eV/Å. Compute the vibrational frequencies at the Γ-point on the relaxed crystal and calculate the corresponding Zero-Point Energy. Return the final answer in eV units
